title: Format a timestamp
responsibility: Display recognizable ISO-like timestamps in the reader’s locale.

inputs.name: timeLabel.value
inputs.description: Recorded label text passed to timeLabel. Only a value beginning with the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm digit pattern and accepted by Date.parse is formatted; other values are returned unchanged.

outputs.name: timeLabel
outputs.description: For parseable timestamp-prefixed input, the result uses the reader’s locale with medium date and short time; the input is returned unchanged when the prefix does not match or parsing fails.
